title: [IMP2-6] The DM admission host member list has no bootstrap, Add ordering or freshness rule
description: Review finding IMP2-6: The DM admission host member list has no bootstrap, Add ordering or freshness rule (lens IMP2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:150-158; spec/07-compliance.md:285. Fix: Sub-points (1) creation authority, (2) the PUT-before-Welcome ordering, (4) replay freshness, and the missing PUT body and status codes are confirmed. The path exists (04:155), but the body encoding and codes do not. Drop sub-point (3), the rogue member. Any DM member can already Remove the others by MLS Commit (04:28, RFC 9420 default), so a member who rewrites the list gains no new power, and the optional Commit-hash rule is unneeded. Fix: the host accepts the first `DMMembers` for a `groupID` only from a DID it hosts; the committer of an Add MUST get a 2xx on the PUT before delivering Welcomes; the host rejects a `DMMembers` whose `ts` is not later than the last accepted one or is more than 300 s from its clock; the body is the `application/cbor` envelope, with 204, 400, 401, 403 and 409. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
